integrity: The complete facet classification of the zero-inclusive consecutive-one interval-vector polytope specializes to coordinate lower facets and alternating-sign upper facets. Two endpoint-complementary upper normals give an exact global upper bound; explicit parity-dependent centers attain it. Three independent forced equality directions and a strict relative-interior witness give the complete incenter affine dimension n-3.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean metric in zero-inclusive, unweighted consecutive-one incidence coordinates only; no radius claim for other affine realizations, branched block graphs, inscribed ellipsoids, or the incenter polytope vertex count.
title: Block-path connected-block polytopes have parity-split inradii and large incenter loci
